paragraphs: Mentioned in Sifrei Devarim 13, on Deuteronomy 1:13 [supplied פ״א-יג׳]. He asked Rabbi Yose, “Who is wise?” He replied, “One who retains what he has learned.” “Do you mean learning, or rather understanding?” He replied, “It already says ‘men of understanding,’” etc.

notes.text: The mixed locator פ״א-יג׳ is kept unresolved rather than assigned a modern section-and-verse division. The dialogue distinguishes wisdom and understanding.

The saved whole VocalizedEdition SifreiDevarim13 scalar contains Arius asking full Rabbi Yose about the wise person, the answer one who maintains his learning, and the contrast with understanding. This supports the matching location beside supplied דברים פ״א-יג׳, without asserting a universal renumbering. It does not identify which Yose or a historical Arius. The quoted dialogue and its negative alternative remain intact.

Hyman’s photographed notice gives Sifrei Devarim 13. The passage there discusses Deuteronomy 1:13 and names Arius and Rabbi Yose. The Jaffee translation adds “the proselyte” in brackets, with no corresponding descriptor in the consulted Hebrew dialogue. The passage leaves their fuller identification open.
